The brake and indicator lights of your tow truck must be clearly visible when you are carrying a vehicle in the cradle of your tow truck. Use portable lights attached to the rear of the towed vehicle.
When you sell or dispose of your vehicle you must return your tow truck plates and the auxiliary number plate to a service centre.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't display an auxiliary number plate?
faqs.a: If you do not display an auxiliary plate clearly and do not use a working light for the auxiliary number plate, you can be fined.

faqs.q: How can I order an auxiliary number plate?
faqs.a: You can order an auxiliary number plate online through myPlates.

faqs.q: What do I need to order an auxiliary number plate?
faqs.a: You need your contact details, your driver licence number or customer number (if a business), your NSW plate number, and your fee payment.
